problem: Queen discovered local Ollama models but preserved an unavailable default cloud selection, so embedded Chat falsely reported that .env keys were missing even though Trios already had a working local provider and selected model.
solution: Added a deterministic Ollama selection policy, preserved valid Queen choices, reused the shared trios.model.ollama.selection preference, rechecked connectivity after automatic model changes, and skipped the standalone fixed-width onboarding only in the embedded host.
lesson: An embedded module should share the host's provider choice, not only its network endpoint. Selection must distinguish a valid user choice from an unavailable default, and host-specific onboarding must not overflow the host window.
